Report: Steelers WR Roman Wilson is expected to miss time with finger injury. Steelers wide receiver Roman Wilson had to leave Sunday's win over the Colts with a finger injury and it looks like he won't be making an immediate return to action.

Roman Wilson was hurt at the end of the first half against the Colts. After he left the game, Germie Bernard tied DK Metcalf with a 91% route share, and he saw 4 of 10 Steelers targets. Even before the injury, though, Bernard had a 25% target share.

The last time we saw the Steelers without Michael Pittman, Roman Wilson ran 60% of his routes out of the slot, and he played in two-wide sets, not Bernard. On Sunday, in the first half, Bernard was in the slot more (56% vs. 25%), and he played in heavier personnel.
